raw.query: SELECT max(abs((v.mean_ms - a.mean_ms) / a.mean_ms)) AS max_error FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn v JOIN provenance.collector_encoder_fn a ON v.n_images = a.n_images AND a.image_px = v.image_px WHERE v.image_px = 448 AND v.engine = 'vllm' AND a.engine = 'aic' AND v.n_images <= 64;
raw.observed: The trace (measured_request table) has 0 image-size columns. At 448px and N <= 64, the maximum cost model error is 12.51% across DB anchors and 12.71% across the full 69-point dense sweep CSV.
raw.claimed: Uniform 448^2 image assumption used; cost model matches vLLM vision tower within 12.8% across serving regime.
raw.evidence: measured_request lacks any pixel-size columns. Comparing vllm and aic mean_ms inside the N<=64 regime yields a maximum error of 12.51% (DB) or 12.71% (dense sweep CSV), both strictly within the 12.8% bound.
